node.label: Robert H Wiebe
node.date_label: Businessmen and Reform (1962) · The Search for Order (1967) · Self-Rule (1995)
node.description: Historian of American social organization and democracy. Northwestern’s archival biography identifies The Search for Order as an interpretation of the transition from local communities toward bureaucratic organization. Ashley Woodiwiss’s substantial reading of Self-Rule emphasizes tensions between participatory self-government, centralization and hierarchy, while retaining the racial and gender exclusions of earlier democracy. These are historically argued models, not inevitable stages.
